go.mod direct bump on a block entry and on a single line require.
-- changes --
[
 {"name":"github.com/acme/lib","ecosystem":"golang","to":"1.4.0","method":"direct","file":"go.mod"},
 {"name":"github.com/acme/one","ecosystem":"golang","to":"0.2.0","method":"direct","file":"go.mod"}
]
-- in:go.mod --
module example.test

require github.com/acme/one v0.1.0

require (
	github.com/acme/lib v1.2.0
)
-- out:go.mod --
module example.test

require github.com/acme/one v0.2.0

require (
	github.com/acme/lib v1.4.0
)
